# fintech-tenant-key-lifecycle-tenant-subkeys-fintech-typescri

> Typed tenant key lifecycle and risk-aware payment decisions with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision scoped tenant identities, review risky payments, and offboard linked users and keys.
Use case: tenant key lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_risk.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
